content: स्वादु {%a.%} [स्वद्-उण्] .({@-दु@} or {@द्वी@} {%f.%}; <ab>compar.</ab> स्वादीयस्, <ab>superl.</ab> स्वादिष्ठ) .²1 Sweet, pleasant to the taste, sapid, savoury, dainty, tasteful; तृषा शुष्यत्यास्ये पिबति सलिलं स्वादु सुरभि <ls>Bh. 3. 92</ls>; <ls>Me. 24</ls>. .²2 Pleasing, agreeable, attractive, lovely, charming. --{%m.%} .²1 Sweet flavour, sweetness of taste, relish. .²2 Treacle, molasses. --{%n.%} .²1 Sweetness, relish, taste; कविः करोति काव्यानि स्वादु जानाति पण्डितः <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²2 Charm, beauty. .{@-दुः@} {%f.%} A grape.
